# Manitoba Chambers of Commerce

## The Challenge

As local businesses struggled with the impact of a second pandemic year, the Manitoba Chambers of Commerce (MCC) sought to increase consumer confidence and encourage local support of the province’s 10,000 businesses in the fall leading up to a critical holiday season. This entailed engaging consumers and business leaders to stimulate long-term behaviour changes and energizing local chamber associations to take part doing the same.

## The 6P Solution

Starting in late summer 2021, #BuyLocalMB ads made their way onto billboards, TV, newspapers, and online as part of a large-scale promotional campaign to get consumers and commercial purchasing professionals buying from Manitoba businesses, with creative switching up twice midway for the shifts into fall and winter.

The #BuyLocalMB hashtag and the tagline “Buy. Brag. Tag.” called on Manitobans to share their local buys on social media and tag their contacts to do the same. The tagline was written to be engaging, brief, and memorable. Eligible posts would be entered for the chance to win a $100 Visa gift card given out every week throughout the campaign.

Promotional boxes filled with Manitoba-produced goodies were distributed to local influencers so they could share and feature on their socials. Campaign-branded tote bags went out to all 67 Manitoba Chambers for distribution around their communities, including to local businesses. A resource portal was also generated so the Chambers network could access over 80 unique downloadable files to print and use locally.  
Meanwhile, a campaign landing page on the Manitoba Chambers website served as a space where Manitobans could watch a video, read up about the initiative, and get inspired.

Finally, we organized a media event at legendary Exchange District business Toad Hall Toys to generate earned media buzz.

## The Outcome

6P came through for the MCC and Manitoba businesses when it counted. #BuyLocalMB ads were seen 37 million times, including 5.6 million times on Google Ads; 3.7 million on Facebook; 1.4 million on Instagram; 1.1 million on YouTube; and millions more on billboards, TV, and in print.

Campaign-related social media posts saw 32,600 engagements (likes, comments, reactions, and shares). Our media event received coverage in eight outlets, and the campaign landing page received 12,600 visits through online channels. #BuyLocalMB achieved considerable awareness and momentum for local business in a time of need.

## Small Business Supports – Digital Marketing or Business Mentorship

Indigenous business owners in Manitoba (rural & Winnipeg) can apply for up to $750 in supports.

Eligible services include:

*   Digital business marketing **OR**
*   Supports from a business mentor

Once approved, funding is paid directly to the service provider/contractor only.  All service providers/contractors must be registered businesses and must provide their business number. Funding is capped at $750 per entrepreneur.

Applications will be reviewed and approved as funding allows.

Eligible services include:

**A) Digital Marketing Supports**

*   Graphic designers
*   Web designers
*   IT supports
*   E-commerce set up assistance
*   Social media set up & content creation
*   Video creation
*   Photography
*   Digital Accessibility

**B) Business Mentorship**

*   Learn business skills from an experienced professional
*   Gain helpful business advice

# Digital Marketing for Small Businesses in Canada: Where to Start in 2026

Digital MarketingBy Code KraftAugust 24, 20266 min read

![Digital Marketing for Small Businesses in Canada: Where to Start in 2026 — Code Kraft Solutions](/img/blog/digital-marketing-small-business-canada.svg)

For a small business, digital marketing can feel overwhelming: social media, Google Ads, SEO, email, content. The good news is that you do not need to do everything at once. This guide explains where Canadian small businesses should start and how to build momentum.

## Step 1: Get Your Foundations Right

Before spending on ads, make sure customers can find and trust you:

*   A fast, mobile-friendly [website](https://codekraftsolutions.com/web-development) with clear services and contact details.
*   A complete Google Business Profile.
*   Consistent business name, address and phone number everywhere online.
*   Active Facebook and Instagram pages.

## Step 2: Understand the Main Channels

### Search engine optimisation (SEO)

SEO helps your site appear in unpaid Google results. It takes time but compounds: each useful page or article can bring visitors for years.

### Google Ads

Paid search ads put you in front of people actively searching for your service, with results you can measure within days.

### Social media marketing

Regular posts, reels, stories and carousels build awareness and trust. Boosted posts and Facebook lead forms turn attention into enquiries.

### Content marketing

Helpful articles answer customer questions and support both SEO and sales conversations. Read our [blogs](https://codekraftsolutions.com/blog) for examples.

## Step 3: Match the Channel to Your Goal

| Goal | Best starting point |
| --- | --- |
| Get found by local customers | Google Business Profile + local SEO |
| Generate leads quickly | Google Ads and Facebook lead forms |
| Build brand awareness | Social media content and boosted posts |
| Build long-term traffic | SEO and blog content |

## Step 4: Be Consistent

Marketing works through repetition. A steady schedule of posts, graphics and content beats occasional bursts. A monthly plan — for example a set number of posts, designed graphics, reels or stories and a carousel — keeps your brand visible.

## Step 5: Measure What Matters

*   Calls, form submissions and bookings — not just likes.
*   Cost per lead from paid campaigns.
*   Which pages and posts bring visitors.

## Should You Hire a Marketing Partner?

If you do not have time to run campaigns, content and account management yourself, a monthly package can be efficient. Our digital marketing packages start at **$499 per month** and cover social media posts and graphic design, content writing, social media optimisation and, at higher tiers, boosted posts, lead forms, ad management, Google Ads and SEO. See details on our [digital marketing page](https://codekraftsolutions.com/digital-marketing) and [pricing](https://codekraftsolutions.com/pricing).

## Next Steps

Start with the foundations, pick one or two channels, and commit to a consistent plan. When you are ready for help, [talk to Code Kraft Solutions](https://codekraftsolutions.com/contact) or [book an appointment](https://www.picktime.com/codekraftsolutions).

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Where should a small business start with digital marketing?

Start with a fast mobile-friendly website, a complete Google Business Profile and active social pages. Then add one or two channels such as SEO, Google Ads or social media.

### How much do digital marketing packages cost?

Code Kraft Solutions' monthly digital marketing packages are $499 (Silver), $799 (Gold) and $999 (Platinum).

### How long does SEO take to work?

SEO is a long-term channel. Results build over months as useful content and authority accumulate, whereas paid ads can produce traffic within days.

Our team in Toronto & Halifax will review your requirements and share next steps.
